name: The Deal
source:
You wake up after what feels like an eternity, surrounded by darkness. Where are you? Who are you? The only person who can answer these questions is a mysterious being... but what exactly do they want from you?

The Deal is a horror visual novel depicting a conversation between the dead and the 'devil'- a look into what may happen when we cross over to the other side.

[From [url=https://monocatari.itch.io/the-deal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在感觉像是永恒之后醒来，周围是黑暗。你在哪里？你是谁？唯一能回答这些问题的人是一个神秘的存在……但他们到底想从你这里得到什么？

《交易》是一部恐怖视觉小说，描绘了死者与“魔鬼”之间的对话——探讨当我们穿越到另一边时可能会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://monocatari.itch.io/the-deal]Itch.io[/url]]
